properties.name: psychosims:distribution-obligation
properties.value: Preserve the complete Flutter engine notice bundle and upstream covered-source availability in each target build. This exact SDK notice inventory is not evidence that all platform binary dependencies have been enumerated; distribution acceptance is pending.
